data_fields.name: zone_centre_xy
data_fields.donor_constant: Area2D origin + CollisionShape2D position, per zone

data_fields.name: zone_width_height
data_fields.donor_constant: RectangleShape2D size as authored (donor reads shape.extents * 2)

best_idea: Give every zone one authored id and a rectangle, build the registry once at load, and answer which zone a point is in with one inclusive box test that returns null outside every zone.
decision_why: Zones are data on one runtime, and row 23 population counts need one unambiguous zone id per point; take the authored box, the single id and the null-outside rule, and reject the node-name key shown to the AI, the silent 100x100 fallback and the origin skip.
acceptance: A server test loads a 9-zone table and asserts each spawn point and test character position resolves to exactly one zone id (never the display name); a point in a gap returns null without error; a zone with a missing rectangle fails the load.
